versions.changelog: Harden first-time reviews: do not auto-apply target-provided .driftguard.json suppressions unless --use-target-config is explicit. Quote raw evidence lines as untrusted data in reports. Add OpenClaw metadata declaring Node runtime requirement.

Rename to DriftGuard Security Scanner+. Add review tickets with human approval checklist, severity rationale, reviewer guidance, trust recommendation, and clearer unscored context signals. Reduce self-scan false positives for process.env and DriftGuard config references.
Avoid raw prompt-injection trigger text in docs, fixtures, and rule descriptions while preserving detection coverage.
Reduce ClawHub static-analysis false positives by removing runtime child process usage and avoiding literal detector module strings while preserving git commit metadata and scanner coverage.
Add trusted baseline approval metadata, risk diffs, improved compare summaries, nested baseline path support, and search-optimized skill description.
Reduce ClawHub static-scan false positive, update OpenClaw {baseDir} usage examples, and fix command-level help handling.
Clean up ClawHub package contents: remove generated report artifacts and keep only the intentional skill files, while preserving the v0.2 trust workflow and updated commands.
Align ClawHub package with v0.2 trust workflow: add trust command, clarify compare/trust baseline usage, improve positioning/copy, and sync packaged scripts with reviewed repo changes.
Fix packaged CLI help/examples to use scripts/cli.js consistently.
v0.2: stronger trust summaries, better manifest drift detection, and template-literal scan fix.
Fix skill runtime packaging, unify script paths, and sharpen artifact usability.
Sharpened positioning: scan before trust, compare after updates.
Initial release: local-first integrity and drift scanner for skills and repos.
